data.headline: Senior Platform Engineer
data.about:
Currently I am developing a cross platform (Android / IOS) game implemented in Unity3D using C#

Technologies

Python, Golang, C/C++, Java, .NET
MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra, Kafka, RabbitMQ, S3
RPC, GRPC, JavaScript, Unity3D, ROS, Gazebo, Matlab, Eigen, PCL,
Matplotlib, Pandas, Jupyter, Numpy, SciPy, Bokeh, Boost, OpenGL, OpenCV

Processor families

• x86 (Windows / Linux), PowerPC (PS3), Atmel AVR (Arduino)

description.text:
Remote (Based in Spain)
● Implemented REST API libraries for surgery video processing and content creation using AWS services (S3, MediaConvert, CloudWatch) 
● Designed and led the development of an immutable layer system that allows multiple versions of annotations of a video using the Django REST Framework with PostgreSQL database
● Worked closely with Data scientists and Machine learning engineers to provide them with clean data and capabilities for anonymization, data insights and machine learning model training
● Implemented and maintained an event-driven video processing and annotation pipeline using Kafka, SQS AWS queues, Celery, Redis
● Code instrumentation and observability (Opentelemetry, Honeycomb, OpenSearch)

● Integration of various third party APIs such as Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS)  and control instrument applications into Revolution automation software in the life science and medical sector.
● Developed communication protocols such as TCP / RS-232 for different devices.
● Added and improved some features of Revolution automation software in .NET.
● Development of a SolidWorks Plugin in C#.

● Responsible for real time data acquisition by parsing feeds from bookmaker APIs at
high frequencies and for an automated trading framework that monitors and creates
order execution capabilities for different bookmakers.
● Implemented strategy trading metrics, risk and profit and loss reports visualised
using the Bokeh API to help traders detect patterns and predict market direction.
● Data distribution and storage through Kafka, Rabbit, Cassandra, Redis, MongoDB
and Amazon Web Services S3.
● Event and market matching implementation for different bookmakers and matching
engine improvements.

experiences.title: Software Engineer I+D
experiences.subtitle: Ingenia Telecom an Astellia company . undefined
experiences.caption: Jun 2014 - Dec 2014 · 6 mos

description.text:
• Developed client-server communication using protocolbuffers for LTE and UMTS protocol (C++ and C#).
• Added functionality in C++ and C# to existing parsers (LTE and UMTS) to parse and insert new fields in SQL Server tables.
• Ported and optimized an existing C# in-house library to C++. This library consisted in geometrical and geolocation algorithms to calculate the end point of a call.

• Integrated Iris recognition into existing Biometric Umanick Identification Server using Java, Spring 3, Hibernate JAX-WS, SOA and JSF 2.
• Supervised, supported and led technical side of junior developers work.
• Development support, optimisation, bug fixing and testing of an Android client application for Umanick Identification Server.

• Implementing a security system communication solution patented by a Norwegian
company called Rosberg.
• The main tasks involve implementing in-house libraries and an SDK for programmers to use the system easily. The system consists of services (daemons) that communicate through the serial port, XML-RPC and AT protocol commands using 3G USB Modems and ARM-based plug computers ( Ionics )
• Implemented functionality to test and update SQLite database using REST and Amazon Web Services EC2.

• Performed research into evaluating sampling-based motion planning and dynamic
motion primitives on a humanoid service robot (REEM), in the context of real-world
tasks. Assessed under which circumstances one approach outperforms the other.

• Adapted and extended existing open-source libraries that implement sampling-based
motion planning and motion primitives approaches. Integrated these methods in the
Robot Operating System (ROS) and applied them to the humanoid robot REEM.

• Implemented collision avoidance for dynamic motion primitives using distance and
potential ﬁelds.

• Submitted a video for The International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Sys-
tems 2012 (IEEE/RSJ). https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yoEj7-qjYJE

• Implemented experiment automation platform to generate and perform experimental analysis of the two approaches to evaluate using C++ for the motion controller and Python for the statistics (NumPy and SciPy libraries).

· Developed water distribution management Netbase application reports using Java
    and PL / SQL.
                                        
· Developed Hydraulic Modelling (GIS) applications using ILOG and JIDE.

· Worked in collaboration with the engineers to analyze and identify problems in the water distribution process.

• Implemented several Wipeout HD high score screens using a C++ GUI system, and
an XML-based server API for leaderboard data retrieval.

• Developed several statistical reporting tools to track player progress in Wipeout HD,
based on a MySQL back-end, outputting data to Excel and CSV.

• Created prototype for real-time messaging bus for scalable notiﬁcation system be-
tween multiple game servers using JGroups. Messages were pushed to the client via
cometd-style persistent HTTP connections using Tomcat 6 Comet-Processor support.

• Developed and managed the MotorStorm Paciﬁc Rift community portal using Spring Portlet MVC and Jetspeed portlet container. Additional features included portlets for integration with Magnolia CMS and Lithium Forums, and in-game leaderboards accessed from a remote server via Spring
HTTP Remoting.
Cost scheduling web application for the University of Valencia. Worked in front end and back end using J2EE, Apache Struts, JavaScript, JSP and JDeveloper.
